spans.s: nibaddha, ppp. of ni-bandh, in aṣṭāpada-ni˚, adorned, laid out, marked out with (or, in) a checkerboard: Mvy 〔6062〕 = Tib. mig maṅs (checkerboard) ris su bris pa (drawn or painted in the form of); SP 〔65.10〕 and 〔145.1〕 suvarṇasūtrāṣṭāpadanibaddhaṃ (with gold threads …). This seems to have been a fairly standard expression; vinibaddha [] (q.v., 2) was also used; the use of vinaddha (q.v.) in the same cpd. seems to be a mere corruption.
